script.hook: Subah chai ke saath, Bhai ke phone par khabar aayi.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie sits at a small kitchen table in the morning, steel cup of chai in one hand, staring excitedly at a glowing phone screen, soft morning light from a window

scenes.vo: Subah chai ke saath, Bhai ke phone par khabar aayi. Meta ki kamai, Wall Street ki umeed se zyada nikli.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: BHAI proudly shows his phone with a mutual fund app to BEHEN in office wear, who stands with folded arms and a sceptical raised eyebrow, living room, morning

scenes.vo: Bhai ki har mahine ek SIP jaati hai, ek foreign tech fund mein. Woh kehta hai, duniya ki badi companies, mera paisa wahin.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI leaning back on a sofa, imagining a thought bubble of a rising green arrow and shining coins, smiling dreamily, daytime

scenes.vo: Usne socha, kamai badhi hai, toh fund bhi chamkega.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI counting on three fingers with a confident grin, three simple doodle icons floating beside him: a big office building, a trophy, a stack of coins, bright daytime

scenes.vo: Logic seedha laga, achhi company, achha result, achha return.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI's thumb hovering over an 'increase' style button on a phone app, a closed locked box labelled only by a fund logo shape sits unopened on the table beside him, afternoon

scenes.vo: Isliye usne SIP badhane ka man bana liya, fund ke andar dekhe bina.

scenes.label: WHAT HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A newspaper on a table with one paragraph glowing, a huge pile of money flowing into giant server racks and computer chips in the background, dramatic evening light

scenes.vo: Par usi khabar mein ek aur line thi, jo Bhai ne padhi nahi. Meta is saal AI par 145 billion dollar tak kharch karegi.

scenes.label: WHAT HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A vast data centre at night with endless rows of blinking server machines, cranes building more halls, tiny workers below for scale

scenes.vo: Isko capex kehte hain, yaani data centre aur machines par bada kharcha. Aaj kharcha, kamai shayad kal.

scenes.label: WHAT HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A big glass jar labelled with a cash symbol shape, almost empty, a hand pouring coins out faster than another hand drops coins in, dim worried lighting

scenes.vo: Kharcha itna bada ki free cash flow minus mein chala gaya. Free cash flow yaani saare kharche ke baad jo cash bacha.

scenes.label: TWIST

visual.prompt: BHAI opens the locked fund box and finds a large slice of a pie chart inside shaped like a tech logo, his eyes wide, mouth open, evening lamp light

scenes.vo: Ab twist suniye, Bhai ke fund ka 10.38 percent hissa sirf Meta hai.

scenes.label: TWIST

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt sits beside BHAI at the table, calmly pointing at the list of companies inside the fund on the phone, BHAI listening thoughtfully, night

scenes.vo: Matlab Bhai ki SIP bhi is AI daav mein shaamil hai. Headline nahi, fund ke andar ki companies dekhiye. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: QUESTION

visual.prompt: BHAI and BEHEN side by side on a sofa at night, both scrolling their phones with curious faces, a warm lamp glowing between them

scenes.vo: Aapki SIP ke andar kaunsi company sabse badi hai, pata hai?
